Line 20 tax from the rate schedule (PDF p.13): 5.8% x (26,800.00 - 0.00) = 1,554.40 + 6.75% x (63,450.00 - 26,800.00) = 2,473.875 + 7.15% x (96,342.00 - 63,450.00) = 2,351.778 = 6,380.053, 6,380.05 to the cent. accepted_approximations: Tax is computed from the rate schedules as numbers. The booklet's table taxes 100-dollar rows and the printed schedule constants are rounded to dollars.
